text:
anika-peopleops: Reporting an odd permissions flow: after we moved a candidate to the "offer" stage, the interviewers couldn't submit their pending scorecards. The submit button was disabled for 3 interviewers.

Tom-recruiter: saw this too yesterday on a couple of fast-moving candidates. Interviewers DMd me saying the UI showed "Read only - stage archived" with no link to save draft.

maria-eng: Can you confirm whether the scorecards were created as panel templates or one-off scorecards?

anika-peopleops: panel templates. They were mid-review when talent ops moved candidate to Offer via quick action.

ats-bot: deployment note: permission-rules update 1991230000 introduced automatic "archive_on_stage: offer" rule for some pipelines.

maria-eng: aha. That rule is intended to prevent edits after offers for compliance, but it looks like it also disabled saving pending draft submissions. Expected behavior: allow final submit from interviewers but block further edits after offer is accepted.

kevin-qa: repro steps I used: 1) create candidate, assign panel, 2) have interviewer open scorecard (leave unsaved checks), 3) move candidate to Offer via quick action, 4) interviewer attempts to submit -> button disabled, no toast. No console errors. Network shows PATCH /scorecards/:id returns 403.

maria-eng: thanks. That 403 is from permissions middleware. The rule is currently evaluated at stage-change time and sets scorecard.permissions = { editable: false } globally. That's too coarse.

anika-peopleops: what's the fix path and ETA? This blocked two offers today because interviewers couldn't record final feedback. We prefer to allow submission for any editor who has an open draft started before the stage change.

maria-eng: plan: (1) add audit: when applying archive_on_stage, also mark existing open sessions with a "grace_submit_until" timestamp (e.g., +30m) tied to session_id and user_id; (2) change middleware to allow PATCH if session_id in grace list even if scorecard marked archived; (3) add server telemetry: scorecard.submit_blocked with scorecard_id, pipeline, user_id.

Tom-recruiter: +1 to grace window. 30m sounds fine but could we make it configurable per-pipeline? Fast-recruiting teams may need longer.

maria-eng: configurable via pipeline settings UI flagged as advanced. Will default to 30m.

kevin-qa: I'll write tests for concurrent session allowance + edge case where grace window expired mid-submit (expect 409 with helpful message). Also will ensure we surface a clear UI notice: "This role has been archived, but your session allows final submit until HH:MM UTC."

anika-peopleops: can we also surface an audit trail entry for compliance showing who submitted after stage change and the grace reason? We need that for reviews.

maria-eng: yes 95 appending audit entry with actor and reason (auto-grace-submit) and linking to session_id.

ats-bot: note: feature-flag grace_submit_on_archive created for staged rollout.

maria-eng: ETA: server change + tests + FF rollout in ~12-18 hours; UI reminder copy and toast in ~24 hours.

Tom-recruiter: I'll hold offers until patch lands for impacted pipelines and brief hiring managers. Also prepping candidate-facing timing messages in case of delay.

anika-peopleops: thanks team. Please post the PR and I'll update #interviewer-announcements with temporary guidance: "If you had an open scorecard when candidate moved to Offer, refresh and submit within 30m; otherwise contact Talent Ops."

maria-eng: PR will be up shortly. Thanks all."
